answer: Each new agent locks a 120 POA anchor deposit and gets no voting weight for 15 epochs. During that wait, a meadow round pairs it each epoch with a random established agent, who asks a fresh question the newcomer must answer live within 60 seconds. An atlas registry logs every account's reply latency and network route; two accounts answering from the same route within 2 seconds of each other both lose their deposit. A 400-account farm must lock 48,000 POA, wait 15 epochs, pass 6,000 live interviews, and one shared route burns it all.
